items.text: Activity log — structured JSON lines for bookmark mutations, status checks, opens (optional), and security events (auth denied, rate limits). Configure with NEXTDASH_ACTIVITY_LOG; optional rotating activity.log under the data directory (NEXTDASH_ACTIVITY_LOG_PERSIST=1).
CSP headers — restrictive Content-Security-Policy on HTML pages by default; set NEXTDASH_CSP=off only when a reverse proxy requires it.
CSP weather — connect-src allows Open-Meteo geocoding and forecast APIs so the dashboard date/weather line works under CSP.
Outbound & SSRF rate limits — per-client caps on server fetches and user-triggered preview/icon APIs (NEXTDASH_OUTBOUND_REQUESTS_PER_MIN, NEXTDASH_SSRF_API_RATE_PER_MIN); returns 429 when exceeded.
Status ping rate limit — bookmark reachability checks use a separate, higher bucket (NEXTDASH_STATUS_PING_RATE_PER_MIN, default 300/min) so many status bookmarks are not all marked offline.

DNS IP pinning — outbound HTTP(S) dials pin resolved public IPs for ~2 minutes so hostnames cannot switch to private addresses between the safety check and the TCP connection (unless localhost bookmarks are allowed).
Startup validation — server exits with a clear error if PORT is outside 1–65535 or NEXTDASH_DATA_DIR is not creatable/writable.
Request context — ping and bookmark-preview outbound calls use the incoming HTTP request context so cancelled clients do not leave orphaned fetches.
Hash-based data revision — GET /api/data-revision fingerprints on-disk file contents instead of mtimes, so restarts and external edits are detected reliably.
Stale cache detection — open tabs refresh when bookmark name, URL, or shortcut changes (in addition to category and tags).
Preview metadata cache — in-memory OG-tag cache flushes every ~30 s and on shutdown instead of on every merge, reducing disk churn while staying fresh.
Tag popover save — quick-tag popover no longer reports success when the underlying bookmark save fails.
Preview save errors — users see a toast when bookmark link-preview metadata fails to persist.
Tag-filter bulk delete — success handling and page-cache sync after bulk delete from a tag filter.
Shared cache-bust tokens — dashboard, config, and health templates read cross-page asset versions from one Go source (asset_versions.go) so tokens stay aligned.

Config → dashboard category sync — bookmark saves keep settings sync (layout chrome, date/weather, toolbar) and force a full dashboard render so category moves appear in the correct column; incremental patch also reparents rows across columns.

Config save layout regression — saving bookmarks from Config no longer drops glass/modern layout or hides date, weather, and toolbar buttons; structure refresh still reapplies setupDOM for tags/finders updates.
Config save settings guard — bookmark-only saves no longer read unchecked General-tab controls into settings, so layout and visibility flags are not accidentally reset.
Device layout overrides — bookmark-only config save no longer clears device-specific dashboard settings stored in the browser.
Status ping UX — HTTP 429 from /api/ping shows as “checking”, not offline, until the rate window clears.
Smart-collection row lookup — category moves and incremental patches ignore duplicate rows in smart collections (e.g. Today) when reparenting bookmarks between columns.
Optional shortcut — Save tab includes a shortcut field; leave empty for an auto-suggested key from the bookmark name (first free letter on the page).
Shortcut on save — extension posts the resolved shortcut to POST /api/bookmarks/add (no longer always empty).
Duplicate shortcut — server returns 409 with a clear message when the shortcut is already taken on that page.
Extension i18n — shortcut placeholder and conflict strings in EN, NL, DE, and FR.
7-release history — scroll the ★ modal to load up to the 7 most recent versions; each release fetches its own JSON on demand.

General layer scroll — Essentials ↔ Advanced keeps the layer toolbar at the same viewport position when scroll is within both layers; preserveScroll now compares the upcoming layer (was always false).
Status re-check default — General → Status defaults to every 5 minutes for background bookmark reachability checks.
README, MANUAL & Config Help — production Docker, environment-variable reference, browser extension, activity log, rate limits, and Security & self-hosting help section (EN/NL/DE/FR).
CI on main — release script keeps tests and Playwright on main after dev-only prune.

Playwright E2E — full suite green: finders empty hints (toBeHidden), config C14 unsaved baseline after tour skip, tags filter empty-hint selector, layout-nudge manual replay (auto promos disabled), General toolbar scroll within Advanced max range; isolated temp NEXTDASH_DATA_DIR per managed run; config→dashboard category sync and bookmark-only settings-guard regression tests.
Tests — activity log categories/dedupe, data-revision hash, stale-cache name/url/shortcut, asset-version drift check.

Cache-bust — whats-new-v124 data version; config-settings-guard-1 on config-persistence.js; status-rate-limit-1 on status.js; config-category-sync-1 on dashboard sync bundles; general-layer-scroll-anchor-2 on config-general-layers.js.
